ideas.title: The 87% Automation Lie
ideas.concept: A data-driven post exposing the real stats behind failed automation attempts. Visual would be a bold stat card showing '87% of business owners try to automate with the wrong tool first' followed by a breakdown of which tools actually fit which jobs (Claude for thinking, N8N for connecting, GoHighLevel for closing). Ends with a direct challenge to audit their current stack.
ideas.hook: 87% of business owners are automating the wrong thing first — and it's costing them six figures a year.

ideas.title: Myth: AI Will Replace Your Team
ideas.concept: A myth-bust carousel post tackling the biggest fear entrepreneurs have about automation. Visual would be a split-screen 'MYTH vs REALITY' format, walking through 4 common misconceptions (AI replaces people, it's too expensive, it's too complex, it's only for tech companies) and dismantling each with a punchy one-liner truth. Positions Accelod as the antidote to the hype.
ideas.hook: AI isn't replacing your team. Bad systems are.

ideas.title: Anatomy of a $0 Lead Follow-Up Machine
ideas.concept: A tool breakdown post showing exactly how Claude + N8N + GoHighLevel + Google Workspace stack together to run lead follow-up on autopilot. Visual would be a clean flowchart diagram: lead comes in → N8N triggers → Claude writes personalised reply → GoHighLevel schedules follow-up → Google Sheets logs it. Shows the actual architecture instead of vague promises.
ideas.hook: Here's the exact 4-tool stack replacing entire sales admin teams — mapped out in one diagram.
